killedBy: the screen baseline: what a diff says (issue #846) prints both values in full when their short forms would read as equal
why: Always prints both values through brief, which collapses whitespace and stops at 72 characters. The comparison is exact, so a change only in whitespace, or only past the cut, fails the check with a line reading `expected "Level 1", got "Level 1"`: a gate that looks flaky, inviting a re-accept that commits the change it was reporting. MEASURED before the fix: formatFailure printed exactly that line for an aria-describedby of "hud-a" against "hud-a ".
